technology.text: The dataset fully refers to the ecoinvent dataset "Wheat straw IP, at farm" for which the input processes "baling" and "loading bale" were removed

representativeness.samplingProcedure: Sampling procedure: Data based on the ecoinvent dataset "Wheat straw IP, at farm" for which the input processes "baling" and "loading bale" were removed to abvoid double counting with the susbsequent process "Rectangular straw bale, baling & loading bales" and on specific data from 2 producers of straw bales for construction in Switzerland
